title: Tune-Up
author: Claude
blurb: The night before the town parade, Gwinn knocks over the Clown Club's instrument trunk. As Teddy, fetch every family of instruments home across thirteen neighborhoods, from the piano shop to the sound card, and hear each one add its part to the parade tune at Doc Leo's bandstand.
